name: Building AI for Quantitative Risk Analysis: Credit, Market and Operational Risk
description: Specific risk-measurement jobs at US banks and fund complexes, each taught as one task: the CECL modeler evaluating ML PD with fixed-LGD ECL, the stress-test modeler building a challenger the Fed's severe scenario will push past history, the market-risk quant explaining backtesting exceptions, and the op-risk analyst classifying loss events with an LLM. Each lesson covers the rule for that task, how to measure success, and an exercise on synthetic data.

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 15 lessons in 5 modules, play each of the course's 6 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
